Hello, and thank you for your request! I really appreciate you reaching out, it made me happy. 
I really enjoy your pixel art and would be honored if you would create an image of Betty Beige my OC. 

My OC is male, but with feminine features and curves. He has a sparkling, glittery beard (not full beard. Just stubble) which is the brand for the OC. He does not have female breats.

He does not consern himself with what society think are women's clothing or men's clothing. He is confident and happy in his own skin, showing acceptance and love to the world. His philosophy in life is to be as authentic to himself as possible, as well as caring for the people around him.

As for the artwork itself, anything is OK. You have full creative freedom. Everything is OK, as long as the glittery stubble is part of the OC. 


There are more reference pictures in the Google 
Drive that is attached, as well as more information about the character's persona

Thank you so much!
